name: inventra-api-docs
description: Tooling-only package: pins Spectral (and its @asyncapi/specs transitive dep) so the OpenAPI lint is reproducible in CI. @asyncapi/specs 6.11.x ships an ESM/CJS mismatch that crashes under Node 24 when pulled fresh via npx, so it is overridden to a known-good version and locked here. fast-uri is pinned to >=3.1.4 to clear GHSA-v2hh-gcrm-f6hx (transitive via Spectral's ajv; CI-lint tooling only).
